<function name="GetProperties" parent="sound" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns properties of a [sound script](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Soundscripts).</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="name" type="string">The name of the sound script</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table{SoundData}">The properties of the soundscript. See <page>Structures/SoundData</page></ret>
	</rets>
</function>
